text: Artificial intelligence is reshaping our world, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if AI learns from flawed data, it can produce unfair results, especially in hiring or lending. Fairness demands that these systems treat everyone equally, regardless of race, gender, or background. Privacy is equally important, as AI often collects huge amounts of personal data without clear consent. Transparency means people should understand how decisions are made, not face a mysterious "black box." To achieve responsible AI development, creators must test their models carefully, involve diverse teams, and follow clear ethical guidelines. Ultimately, technology should serve humanity, not harm it. When we design with honesty and care, AI can benefit everyone fairly.
